string-array.name: novidades
string-array.item: TV: the same channel in 4K, Full HD, HD and SD is now a single channel; the TV picks the quality by itself and steps down if the picture stalls (Options › Quality to choose by hand)
TV: leaner left menu; All and Guide sit next to LISTS and Radio left (it is in Listen)
TV: New category with the channels added to the list in the last 14 days
TV: when a channel does not open, the TV tells you if the list expired or another screen is using it
New “Line” icons: thin stroke, one color, and the selected item lights up in the brand color (the other styles are still in Settings › Home screen)
Apps show their TV banner, without the square; “App icons” in Settings switches to round or symbol only
Each app lands in the right category on its own (YouTube in Watch, Spotify in Listen); hold OK on an app and pick “Move to…” to change it
Play: each game in the column, last played first, and the Game hub on top with the Discord crew, controllers, network and playtime this week
Continue also shows the last radio station, the podcast you were halfway through, recent games and what you watched or heard on YouTube, Spotify, Netflix and other apps

On the home screen, the selected item gets an orange dot left of its name, and the line below wraps to up to 4 lines instead of being cut; TV shows the channel, what is on now with the time left, and what is next with its time

string-array.name: roteiro_perguntas
string-array.item: In the TV list, do more categories fit, with All and Guide next to LISTS and no Radio?
Does a channel that used to repeat (4K, FHD, HD) show only once, and does ▶ ▶ › Quality show the choices?
Are the home screen icons in a thin stroke, with only the selected item in orange?
Holding OK on an app and choosing “Move to… › Watch”, does it appear in the Watch column?
After watching something on YouTube or listening on Spotify, does the title show in Continue and OK go back to it?
With TV selected in Watch, do you see the orange dot, the channel, what is on now with the time left and what is next, with nothing cut off?
